name: validate_handoff
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();r=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());v=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text());assert set(r)==set(map(str,v['ids']))
prov=json.loads((p/'provenance.json').read_text());assert len(prov)==20
for row in prov:
 raw=(p/('originals/'+str(row['id'])+'.jsonl')).read_bytes();o=json.loads(raw)
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==row['raw_sha256'] and raw.endswith(b'\n')
 assert row['raw_statement_token'] is not None
 assert json.loads(row['raw_statement_token'])==o['statement']
 assert hashlib.sha256(o['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==row['statement_sha256']
 assert hashlib.sha256(row['raw_statement_token'].encode()).hexdigest()==row['raw_statement_token_sha256']
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in (p/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];prev='0'*64
for seq,raw in enumerate((p/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)):
 o=json.loads(raw);assert o['seq']==seq and o['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
b=json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text());charges=[json.loads(s) for s in (p/'search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert b['calls_used']==len(charges)==3 and b['queries_used']==sum(len(x['queries']) for x in charges)==9
print('20 exact original bindings and20keyed gates; guard chain and3/9 search continuity authenticated. Documentary validation only.')
print('History files',len(json.loads((p/'history-access.json').read_text())))
print('Failed receipts',[(q.name,json.loads(q.read_text()).get('exit')) for q in p.glob('*.receipt.json') if json.loads(q.read_text()).get('exit')!=0])
